entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi... I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how this all works. It's all very confusing.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with a return. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... VF789012. It's about the shoes I bought.

Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, preference I guess? I tried them once and they just... hurt. I think I installed the cleats wrong, they felt wobbly and gave me awful blisters on my heels. I just don't understand them. The website didn't explain it well. Can't you just help me? I just want a refund.
I'm so sorry to hear about the blisters, Sarah. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I can absolutely help you with this. Let me just confirm a few details.

I see here the shoes were delivered just seven days ago. Since these cycling shoes are a standard item, you are well within our 90-day return policy. I can process this return for a full refund for you right away. No problem at all.
Oh, really? It's that easy? Thank you! I was so worried I was going to be stuck with them.

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account now. Also, I see that you're a VIP member with us. To apologize for the confusing setup and the trouble this has caused, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for a future purchase.
Wow, a credit too? That's so nice of you. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this completely painless.
You're very welcome, Sarah. We appreciate your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for being a VeloFit VIP.
